title: App shell
description: The providers at the root, safe areas, a screen header and a bottom tab bar, for a new app or its navigation

quality.providers: SafeAreaProvider, then ThemeProvider insets={useSafeAreaInsets()} with the web app's style options, then ToastProvider: once, at the root
quality.edges: safeArea={["top"]} on the screen, safeArea={["bottom"]} on the tab bar; nothing pads for the notch by hand
quality.tabBar: Three to five tabs, each an Icon over a one-word label-default-xs Text in a Card with flex={1}, brand-strong for the current tab, on background="surface" under a Line
quality.header: The screen title as Heading heading-strong-xl on the left, at most two IconButtons (variant="tertiary", aria-label) on the right
